title: How Netflix Turns a Third of Every Dollar Into Profit
summary: In 2022, Netflix lost subscribers for the first time in a decade. In mid-2026, it kept 34.6 cents of operating profit from every dollar it earned. We take Netflix's latest shareholder letter apart, dollar by dollar: where the money comes from, where it goes, and the four levers behind the margin (higher prices, the password-sharing crackdown, the ad plan, and live sports), plus the content accounting that turned years of cash burn into billions of free cash flow.
